Extended producer responsibility (EPR) can make brands help finance garment collection and end-of-life management, and eco-modulated fees could reward durable, repairable designs. It may also fund repair, reuse, and recycling infrastructure, but benefits depend on strong rules: otherwise EPR can prioritize collection or recycling without reducing production or waste. Track garment lifetimes, repair and reuse rates, and final destinations, with safeguards for workers and smaller businesses.
